bancroft_entry_verbatim: Maria Ester, Mex. brig, 170 or 93 tons; owned by Henry Virmond, who was on board in 1828; Davis, master
Clarita, Mex. bark, 202 tons; Chas Wolter, master. Paid $382 in spring of 1841
Cowlitz, Engl. bark, 312 or 345 tons; Wm Brotchie, master. At Mont. Aug.-Oct. 1841 from Col. Riv.
Guadalupe, Cal. schr, 60 tons; built by Jos Chapman, and launched at S. Pedro in 1831
vol III: 'Ayacucho, Engl. brig, 232 tons; Joseph Snook, master; arr. Mont. from Honolulu Oct. 1830' || vol IV: 'Ayacucho, Mex. schr, 93 tons; J. Blanca, master'
Fanny, Fr. whaler, 409 or 364 tons; Duval, master
Maria, Hamburg or Danish brig, 109 tons; W. Holstein, master
Juanita, Haw. (?) schr, 102 or 126 tons; John Wilson, master
Triton, whaler, 300 tons, 1825-6; Jean Opham, or Ibre Albet (?), masters. Perhaps two vessels.
Clementine, Engl. brig, 93, 76, or 160 tons. (The records are inextricably confused, and there may have been 2 vessels of this name)
